source: Outokumpu Core range datasheet, physical properties Table 7 (p. 10), Core 304/4301 row
quantity: linear thermal expansion coefficient across 20 to 100 degrees Celsius
role: Grade-level interval mean. Treating it as constant between the endpoints is an engineering approximation for the kinematic screen only; not a measured stop or a pointwise tangent function.
uncertainty: Not reported. No probability distribution assigned.
